notes:
What's new in 0.2.0:

- Full rewrite is here. Turn it on in Settings with a Groq key and Dicta polishes your speech the same way the Mac does — and it can never answer you back or delete words you said: every rewrite is checked against what you actually spoke, and anything suspicious falls back to plain cleanup so your words always survive.
- Your dictation lands the way you meant it. Dicta now reads the text right before your cursor: mid-sentence dictations stop getting a stray capital letter, and back-to-back dictations stop getting squished together.
- Undo that can't eat your work. Press the undo chord and Dicta removes its last dictation only when it can prove that exact text is still there — if you typed something after, or selected text, or switched windows, it refuses instead of guessing.
- Copy-last and a real tray menu: pause dictation, recent dictations, cleanup and language switches, all from the tray.
- The Overview tab now shows your real stats — words, streaks, time saved — computed exactly like the Mac, so both machines agree.
